description: #11 ARX X5 arm limits: generator input for docs/params/robots.json robots.x5.arm_limits (audit/tools/build_docs_params.py). Values are copied from the cited files at the pinned commits; nothing is derived.

arx5_sdk.range_use_quote: controller_base.cpp L486-499 (update_output_cmd_): if (output_joint_cmd_.pos[i] < robot_config_.joint_pos_min[i]) ... output_joint_cmd_.pos[i] = robot_config_.joint_pos_min[i]; (and the same for joint_pos_max): every command is clipped to the range
arx5_sdk.velocity_use_quote: controller_base.cpp L501-519: if (std::abs(delta_pos) > max_vel * dt) { double new_pos = prev_output_cmd.pos[i] + max_vel * dt * delta_pos / std::abs(delta_pos); ...: the command, not the measured joint, is slew-limited
arx5_sdk.torque_use_quote: controller_base.cpp L368-398 (over_current_protection_): if (std::abs(joint_state_.torque[i]) > robot_config_.joint_torque_max[i]) over_current = true; ... if (over_current_cnt_ > controller_config_.over_current_cnt_max) enter_emergency_state_(); and L580-594 clip the feed-forward torque command to +-joint_torque_max
arx5_sdk.torque_units_note: joint_state_.torque is the SDK's reading: current_actual_float * 1.4 * 1.4 for EC_A4310 (joints 1-3, controller_base.cpp L438-443, 'Why are there two torque_constant_EC_A4310?') and current_actual_float * 0.424 for DM_J4310 (joints 4-6, L444-448). Whether these equal output torque in N*m is unverified (#71 phase1.md A.3 on the 0.424 constant)
arx5_sdk.motor_quote: config.h L109-111: std::vector<int>{1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7}, // motor_id; MotorType::EC_A4310, MotorType::EC_A4310, MotorType::EC_A4310, MotorType::DM_J4310, MotorType::DM_J4310, MotorType::DM_J4310 // motor_type
arx5_sdk.frame_check: arx5-sdk models/X5.urdf and RoboDojo's X5A.urdf have the same joint axes (z, y, y, y, z, x) and origins within 4 mm, so zero positions and signs agree and the ranges apply unchanged

dm_j4310_peak_torque_nm.source: audit/out/32/phase1.md A.2 (Damiao DM-J4310-2EC V1.1 manual p. 7: Rated Torque 3NM, Peak Torque 7NM; V1.2: 3.5NM / 12.5NM)
